Project : I Pod

Hey guys! i have planned to build a project which is like a small, compact iPod. i suffered from heavy fever past days, I always find i-pods cool, because it looks nice hehe. Today I completely researched for the building materials i figured out the things i need for the i-pod like we would need a 3.5 mm audio jack to put a headphones in, and hear musicc.
